_doc: Ingredients are property bags. Recipes and customer preferences are matched against `tags`, never against ingredient ids, so a new ingredient slots into the existing menu without touching code.

dragon_beef.name: Dragon Beef
dragon_beef.desc: Cut from cattle that graze too close to the volcano. Sears itself if you are slow.

shadow_herb.name: Shadow Herb
shadow_herb.desc: Grows in the dark under old roots. Tastes like a rumour.

moon_berry.name: Moon Berry
moon_berry.desc: Only ripens under moonlight. Picks itself if you ask nicely.

cave_mushroom.name: Cave Mushroom
cave_mushroom.desc: Reliable, earthy, entirely unremarkable. The backbone of the menu.

ghost_mushroom.name: Ghost Mushroom
ghost_mushroom.desc: Visible only at night. Cooks in a pan you are not holding.

gold_mushroom.name: Gold Mushroom
gold_mushroom.desc: Worth more than the dish it goes in. Use it anyway.

frost_root.name: Frost Root
frost_root.desc: Keeps the kitchen cold and the desserts colder.

bone_meal.name: Bone Meal
bone_meal.desc: Do not ask whose. The Countess insists it is traditional.

night_cheese.name: Night Cheese
night_cheese.desc: Aged in a cellar that is bigger on the inside.

witch_salt.name: Witch Salt
witch_salt.desc: Marrow will not say where it comes from. It fixes almost anything.

star_syrup.name: Star Syrup
star_syrup.desc: Collected during meteor showers. Sticky. Faintly humming.

crimson_sap.name: Crimson Sap
crimson_sap.desc: The Countess calls it 'acceptable'. From her, that is a rave.

thunder_egg.name: Thunder Egg
thunder_egg.desc: Hums before it cracks. Gives you about two seconds of warning.
